The setter should normalize keys before storing them because mixed-case writes cannot be retrieved.

## Changes
Adds `Cache.set`, increases the default TTL to 300 seconds, and adds round-trip and expiration tests. Tests were read, not run.

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize keys before storing entries — Calling `set("ALPHA", 1)` followed by `get("alpha")` returns `None`: the setter stores the original key, while the getter lowercases every lookup. The added round-trip test only writes a lowercase key. — Callers writing uppercase or mixed-case keys cannot retrieve their values or replace existing lowercase entries.
